visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short, styled dark hair wearing a light blue denim jacket stands in a modern kitchen. He claps his hands and gestures enthusiastically toward the camera while holding a white plastic food pouch. The lighting is bright and artificial. (2) Close-up shot of a small light-purple pot on a gas stove. A hand points at chunks of duck blood and tofu simmering in a dark brown broth. Numerical overlays from 1 to 8 appear as the pieces are counted. (3) The camera focuses on the pot again, showing wide noodles and large pieces of beef being stirred with wooden chopsticks. Steam rises from the pot. (4) Transition to a man in a black hoodie sitting at a wooden table with a bowl of noodles. He looks off-camera and smiles. (5) The first man in the denim jacket is shown eating noodles vigorously from a white bowl. He holds up a red product box with white lettering. (6) A woman with glasses and a beige sweater is shown in a room with shelves full of books and boxes. She lifts a very large piece of braised meat from her bowl with chopsticks. (7) The woman eats while looking at the camera. The man in the denim jacket is briefly seen talking in the same room. (8) A candid shot shows the woman eating while the man in the black hoodie enters the frame from the right, surprising her. (9) The man in the black hoodie eats from a bowl and uses a fork to lift a large rib, showing it to the camera with a wide smile. (10) The camera pans up to a tall shelf filled with numerous colorful boxes of food products before returning to the woman sitting at the desk. (11) A hand gives a thumbs-up in the foreground with a heart sticker on the nail, while the woman in the background smiles at the camera.

(2) Sounds of liquid bubbling and boiling are layered under the narration. The speaker's pitch rises as he begins counting excitedly. (3) A distinct metallic clink of chopsticks hitting the side of a pot is heard. The BGM remains consistent with a steady 4/4 electronic drum pattern. (4) Frequent slurping sounds and chewing noises are introduced as the speaker eats. A female voice joins, expressing high-pitched enthusiasm. (5) Footsteps and the rustle of clothing accompany the arrival of a third speaker. Multiple voices overlap in a jovial, laughing manner, creating a lively indoor room tone. (6) A sharp 'ding' sound effect emphasizes a visual text overlay. The dialogue transitions to a promotional announcement with the main speaker's voice becoming more projected and authoritative.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Multi-product Demonstration -> Lifestyle Integration -> CTA/Promotional Offer
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle-integrated commercial aimed at promoting '藍海饌' instant food products. It uses a high-energy vlog format featuring multiple influencers to showcase product variety, ease of preparation, and taste through dramatic food reveals and humorous interactions, concluding with a limited-time group buy offer.
